options.region: No tenant regions selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Org-scoped Entra OIDC, fixed workforce tenant; JIT create/update; native SCIM User only; no group or SaaS bridge

conditions: Use the Microsoft provider template with a registered Entra Web app, callback, client credentials and a fixed workforce Tenant ID; activate org-scoped external login with explicit organization targeting.
Common, Organizations and Consumers tenant selectors are outside this single-tenant scope; do not substitute Entra External ID or assume verified email from profile claims.
The Free offer at https://zitadel.com/pricing has quotas; Cloud and upstream Entra entitlements are unverified, not a zero-cost guarantee.

evidence.summary: The Microsoft guide provides tenant selection and organization activation. This proposal selects one workforce tenant, not a tested customer or AuthWeave login change.

conditions: Explicitly select automatic creation and automatic update for this org-scoped provider; creation and profile updates occur at login, not through background provisioning.
Account linking and email trust require a separate reviewed policy; login-time JIT is not SCIM deactivation or SaaS session revocation.

evidence.summary: Provider settings describe optional automatic user creation and profile updates at login. They do not establish lifecycle synchronization.

conditions: The API is marked Preview; Free-plan access, deployed Cloud version and upstream Entra provisioning entitlement remain unverified. UNKNOWN is not UNAVAILABLE.
An organization-scoped User API alone does not prove this Entra pairing or its identity correlation; do not inherit Auth0-specific oid/objectId/externalId mapping.
Inbound SCIM users in ZITADEL are not outbound provisioning into the SaaS; authorization, account linking, deactivation and consuming-app session enforcement need separate tests.

evidence.summary: The Preview API documents organization-scoped User operations. It does not verify commercial access, a Cloud release or interoperability with this Entra OIDC configuration.

conditions: Limited to native inbound SCIM Group provisioning: the User-only interface excludes Group resources, and no external bridge is selected.
Do not generalize to other APIs or extensions; login claims and user metadata are not synchronized SaaS group membership.

evidence.summary: The SCIM guide excludes Groups from the native User interface. The proposed absence is limited to this interface, not all ZITADEL integrations.
